verses.text: Ubu ni ubutumwa bwahawe umuvugishwa Habakuki.
Yewe Uhoraho , mbega nzogeza ryari kuguhamagara ngo umfashe, ariko ntunyumve, canke nkagutakira kubera umuryano ariko ntutabare?
Ni kuki utuma ndaba akarenganyo? Ni kuki wihanganira ibikorwa bibi? Guhonya n’umuryano biri imbere yanje; kandi imitongano n’amatati biri ahantu hose.
Ni co gituma ivyagezwe bitagikurikizwa, n’ubutungane ntibwubahirizwe. Umunyakibi aratsinda umugororotsi, ubutungane bugasibanganywa.
“Nimwitegereze amahanga, murabe hanyuma mutangare mwumirwe. Kuko mu gihe canyu, ngiye gukora ikintu mutokwigera mwemera, naho hogira uwukibabwira.
Ngiye guhagurutsa Abanyababiloni, ubwoko bw’inkazi kandi butagira imbabazi, buzoca mw’isi yose bwigarurire ibindi bihugu.
Ni abo gutinywa kandi bateye ubwoba. Bishingira amategeko nk’uko bishakiye bakigwiriza icubahiro.

Amafarasi yabo anyaruka kurusha ingwe, akerebutse kurusha imfyisi zihiga iyo bwije. Abagendera ku mafarasi babo basimbagurika bihuta, kandi abagendera ku mafarasi babo baza bava kure. Baguruka kurya kw’inkona iyo yihutira gucakira ico irotsa.
Bose bazanwa no gutera intambara. Amasinzi yabo agenda nk’umuyaga wo mu bugaragwa, bakegeranya imbohe zingana n’umusenyi.
Batwenga abami, bagashinyagurira abaganwa. Basuzugura ibisagara vyabo bizitiriwe; maze bakagira ibirundo vy’ivu, bakurira bakabifata.
Bagenda bihuta nk’umuyaga iyo uriko urahita. Ariko ni abo gutsindwa n’urubanza kuko inkomezi zabo ari zo mana yabo.”
Yewe Uhoraho , mbega nturi Iyihoraho? Mana yanje, Uwera, utazokwigera upfa. Yewe Uhoraho , wabashiriyeho gushitsa amateka yawe; yewe gitandara canje, wabategetse kuduhana.
Ariko inyonga zawe ziratunganye ntizikunda kuraba ikibi, ntiwihanganira inkozi y’ikibi. None ni kuki wihanganira abanyazi? Ni iki gituma wirengagiza iyo umunyakibi amira uwumusumvya ubugororotsi?
Abantu wabagize nk’amafi yo ku kiyaga, bamera nk’ibiremwa vyo mu mazi bitagira umurongozi.
Umunyakibi akwegesha abantu igera, akabategesha urusenga nk’urwo kuroba, akabegeraniriza mu co aroberamwo amafi, hanyuma akanezerwa, agahimbarwa.
Maze agashikanira ibimazi izo nsenga, ico aroberamwo akagituririra ibimota neza, kuko kubera urwo rusenga abayeho ubuzima bw’ibihimbaro bikomeye, agahindura imfungurwa uko ashatse.
Mbega azokwama asuka ibiri mu rusenga, atikiza amahanga ata kagongwe?
Nzoduga ku munara wanje, mpagarare ku kirindiro canje. Nzorindira ico ambwira, menye n’ico ndamwishura kuri aya maganya.
Maze Uhoraho aranyishura, ati: “Andika ivyo uhishuriwe, ubishire ahabona ku bisate vy’amabuye ku buryo vyorohera gusoma, uwugenda asemerera.”
Kuko ivyo wahishuriwe birafise igihe bizoshikirako. Bivuga ivy’igihe c’iherezo, kandi ntibibesha. Naho vyoteba, ubirindire; nta nkeka bizoba, kandi ntibizoteba.
“Raba umwansi yishize hejuru; ivyipfuzo vyiwe ntibiroranye. Ariko umugororotsi azobeshwaho n’ukwizera kwiwe.”

Ni ukuri, umuvinyu uramuhenda; yuzuye ubwibone kandi ntiyigera atekana. Ameze kurya kw’imva itigera ihaga, kandi ameze kurya kw’urupfu rutigera rushirwa, yiyegeranirizako amahanga yose, akagira imbohe abantu bose.
“Ariko, mbega abo bose ntibazomuhindura ikimaramare, bitwengera bavuga bati: ‘Azobona ibara uwirundaniriza ivyo yasahuye, akitungisha mu vyo yagunze abandi! Mbega azobikora kugeza ryari?’ ”
Mbega abo mufitiye imyenda ntimuzobwirwa n’uko babahagurukiye? Ntibazokwikangura bagatuma mujugumira? Maze muzohinduka umunyago wabo.
Kuko wasahuye amahanga menshi, abacitse kw’icumu na bo bazobasahura. Kuko mwasheshe amaraso y’abantu; mukarandura ibihugu n’ibisagara, ndetse n’ababibamwo bose.
Azobona ibara uwiyubakira inzu mu nyungu mbi, akishirira icari ciwe hejuru, kugira ngo yikingire icago cose.
Ariko waranduye amahanga menshi, uteza isoni inzu yawe bwite kandi uzanira akaga ubugingo bwawe.
Amabuye yubatse impome azobaha induru, ibiti bizisakaye biyakire.
“Azobona ibara uwubakisha igisagara gusesa amaraso, agakomeresha igisagara akarenganyo.”
Mbega Uhoraho Mushoboravyose si we yashinze ko abantu baruhira ibizotongorwa n’umuriro, n’amahanga akaruhira ubusa?
Kuko isi izokwuzura ukumenya ubwiza bw’ Uhoraho , nk’uko amazi yuzura ikiyaga.
“Azobona ibara uwuha inzoga mugenziwe, akamusukira iyiri mu mubindi gushika aborewe, kugira ngo abone ubwambure bwiwe.”

Uzotwikirwa n’isoni mu gishingo c’icubahiro. Ubu ni wewe uramukiwe! Nunywe nawe, ubwambure bwawe bugaragare. Igikombe co mu kuboko kw’i buryo kw’ Uhoraho kirabashikiriye, kandi ubumaramare ni bwo buzosubirira ubwiza bwanyu.
Ibibi wakoreye Libani bizokurengera, kandi agatikizo wagiriye inyamaswa zaho kazogutera ubwoba. Kuko washeshe amaraso y’abantu, utikiza ibihugu, ibisagara, hamwe n’ababibamwo bose.
“Mbega igishushanyo kibazwa n’umuntu kimaze iki? Canke ikibumbano kivuga ibinyoma? Kuko ababibumba bizigira ivyo bakoze bo nyene; bakora ibigirwamana bidashobora no kuvuga.
Azobona ibara uwubwira igiti cumye ati: ‘Ba muzima!’ canke akabwira ibuye ati: ‘Kanguka!’ Mbega igishushanyo cokwereka inzira? Cometseko ifeza n’inzahabu ahantu hose; ntikigira ubuzima muri co.”
Ariko Uhoraho avyagiye mu Ngoro yiwe yera; amahanga yose nahwekere imbere yiwe.
Iri ni isengesho ry’umuvugishwa Habakuki, riririmbwa mw’ijwi rya Shigiyonoti.

Uhoraho , numwise ukwamamara kwawe, mpagarara ntewe ubwoba n’ibikorwa vyawe bitangaje, yewe Uhoraho . Subira ubikore muri kino gihe cacu, bimenyekanishe mu gihe co kubaho kwacu; ariko mu burake bwawe, wibuke kugira imbabazi.
Imana yazananye i Temani, Uwera yaturutse ku musozi Parani. Sela. Ubwiza bwayo bwari butwikiriye amajuru, kandi amashimwe yayo yuzuye isi.
Ubwiza bwayo bwari bumeze nk’izuba rirashe; imishwarara yava mu kiganza cayo, ahari hanyegejwe ububasha bwayo.
Agatikizo kagendera imbere yayo; akaranda kagakurikira ibirenge vyiwe.
Maze irahagarara, inyiganyiza isi; iritegereza, ijugumiza amahanga. Imisozi yahozeho irasaduka, n’imitumba ya kera cane irasenyuka. Inzira zayo ni iz’ibihe bidashira.
Nabonye amahema y’ab’i Kushani yuzuye umubabaro, n’Abamidiyani aho baba hihebuye.
Yewe Uhoraho , mbega wari urakiye inzuzi? Uburake bwawe bwari ku masoko? Mbega wari uhagurukiye ibiyaga aho waza kw’ifarasi no mu mikogote y’intsinzi?
Wasokoroye umuheto, wegeranya imyampi myinshi. Sela. Watandukanije isi ukoresheje inzuzi,
imisozi yarakubonye irashonga. Amasumo y’amazi arahita, i bwina mu kiyaga hakumvikana urwamo, kigaterera imipfunda yaco hejuru.
Izuba n’ukwezi birahagarara kw’ijuru kubera imyampi irashwe, n’ukurabagiza kw’icumu ryawe ritewe.
Wagendagenze mu gihugu ufise umujinya, uhonyangisha amahanga ugukara kwawe.
Wazanywe no gucungura ubwoko bwawe, no gukiza uwo wasize amavuta. Wafyonyoye umutware w’igihugu cuzuye ikibi, uramuvunagura kuva ku mutwe gushika ku birenge. Sela.
Watobekeranishije umutwe wiwe icumu ryiwe, igihe ingabo ziwe zari zije kudushwiragiza, babikorana umunezero mwinshi ngo bahonye umworo aho yari yinyegeje.
Wahonyangishije ikiyaga ifarasi zawe, hamwe n’imikuba y’amazi menshi.

Naravyumvise nsimbwa n’umutima, iminwa yanje ijugumizwa n’iryo jwi; ukubora kwinjira mu magufa yanje, amaguru yanje arajugumira. Ariko nzorindira nihanganye umusi w’amakuba, aho uzozira kw’ihanga ryaduteye.
Naho umusukoni wanje utoshurika, inzabibu zanje ntizame, naho umwimbu wa elayo worumba imirima ntigire ico yera, naho intama zohera mu rugo, umukuku ugahera mu ruhongore,
nzonezererwa Uhoraho , nzohimbarirwa Imana y’agakiza kanje.
Uhoraho Nyeninganji ni we nkomezi zanje; akomeza ibirenge vyanje nk’ivy’ingeregere, anshoboza kugendera ku dutwe tw’imisozi.

headings.text: Ku mukuru w’abaririmvyi: Iri sengesho rizoririmbwe hakoreshejwe ibicurarangisho vy’imirya.
